claim: Amazon ECS tasks for AWS Fargate require the awsvpc network mode, which provides each task with an elastic network interface; when you run a task or create a service with this network mode, you must specify one or more subnets to attach the network interface and one or more security groups to apply to it.

evidence.quote: Amazon ECS tasks for AWS Fargate require the `awsvpc` network mode, which provides each task with an elastic network interface. When you run a task or create a service with this network mode, you must specify one or more subnets to attach the network interface and one or more security groups to apply to the network interface.
